title: Rust conformance runner for features/data
description:
`crates/apricitus-data/tests/conformance.rs`: a cucumber-rs runner that implements every pattern in `features/data/STEPS.md` over `Engine::call`, on a `MemoryStorage` library opened with the contract. It runs every feature except `@realtime` and `@sandbox`. The `@auth` scenarios run with `enforce_auth`.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricitus-data --test conformance` all green. Paste the summary line.

---
**Repo:** `~/Projects/Ripple`, branch `master` (don't switch).
**Toolchain:** `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH`; Python `analysis/.venv/bin/python`; web `cd web && npm …`.
**Protocol:** initiative `apricitus-e70662`: specs first; log with `kbs comment`; run **Verify** and paste the output tail; label `ready-for-review`; never commit, push, close, or deploy. Don't change visuals in `web/src/ui/*` (the web session owns them); data calls only.
